subject.title: [Feature]: Settings profile page — lifetime token stats, streaks, and activity heatmap

question: Should Control UI settings gain a separate Profile page for lifetime usage identity stats, or should this remain part of the existing Usage dashboard?
rationale: This is a new user-facing product surface with additive Gateway response fields, and the issue already has a protected maintainer label plus an open implementation PR.

options.title: Review the linked Profile PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the proposed UI and Gateway aggregate additions in the linked pull request.

options.title: Keep usage in the existing dashboard
options.body: Reject the separate Profile surface and close the paired pull request if maintainers do not want this in core Control UI.

recommendation.title: Review the linked Profile PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the proposed UI and Gateway aggregate additions in the linked pull request.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter opened the request and implementation PR and also appears in recent Control UI history, so he has the clearest product-context trail.
